Name: Little crocodile Fenrir
Author: fenrirli
Description:
[size=6][b]🐊 Description[/b][/size]

[size=5][b]About Fenrir[/b][/size]
[size=4]Fenrir is a custom NPC mod for Stardew Valley.[/size]

[size=4]He is a small adult crocodile who has traveled a long way to Pelican Town, fleeing a rather... peculiar past, and searching for the spark of his own life. His story centers around uncertainty, self-acceptance, and the quiet comfort of being understood.[/size]

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]1. A New Companion:[/b] Meet Fenrir, a gentle and quirky crocodile traveler trying to settle down in Pelican Town—and stay by your side.[/size]
[size=4][b]2. Unique Schedule & Dialogues:[/b] Custom daily routines, seasonal lines, and location-based conversations.[/size]
[size=4][b]3. Heart Events:[/b] Unfold Fenrir's backstory and watch his journey of finding a home (spoilers kept hidden for you to discover!).[/size]
[size=4][b]4. Personalized Soundtrack:[/b] Features 4 carefully chosen songs woven into his events, each holding special memories from our journey together. 🎵[/size]

[size=5][b]Gift Tastes[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Loves:[/b] Blackberries, Coffee, Quartz, and fresh Fish![/size]
[size=4][b]Dislikes:[/b] Anything related to "mud inspection" or garbage.[/size]

[size=5][b]Technical Notes & Debugging[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
[code]Stardew Valley 1.6+
SMAPI 4.0+
Content Patcher[/code][size=4][b]Useful SMAPI Debug Commands:[/b][/size]
[code]debug where Fenrir
# Checks Fenrir's current location[/code][code]debug wtc Fenrir
# Warps the player to Fenrir's current location[/code][code]debug friend Fenrir 2500
# Raises friendship for event testing[/code][code]debug ebi <event ID>
# Removes a seen event from the save file, allowing it to trigger again for testing[/code][size=4][b]Known event IDs:[/b][/size]
[code]970100 - Intro / early Fenrir event
970101 - 2 heart event
970102 - 4 heart event
970103 - 6 heart event[/code][size=4]If Fenrir does not appear where expected after updating the mod, fully close and restart the game before testing again.[/size]


[size=5][b]Future Updates[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]The Final Chapter:[/b] The story is already complete, but the final, most meaningful heart event will be revealed at just the right time : )[/size]

[b][size=5]Few Words for Sophie[/size][/b]
[size=4]Happy Birthday to the most special person in my life! 🎉 [/size]

[size=4]Since I met you, I have always been quietly watching you face the challenges in your life. From reflecting on the little things in your relationships with the world around you, to slowly finding and confirming the path you want to take in life, I have seen you become a calmer, stronger, and more self-aware person through these experiences. I think that is truly incredible.[/size]
[size=4]
I know the past two years have not been easy for you. Getting through last year took so much strength, and this period has brought countless day-to-day matters for you to handle and worry about. It must have been exhausting at times. But whenever you need someone to listen, to share your thoughts and feelings with, I want you to know that I am always here.[/size]
[size=4]
When you were in Finland, you told me that whenever you felt cold and down, you would open Stardew Valley and disappear into that warm world for a while. So I made this little crocodile mod for you. I hope his story can bring you some comfort during this chapter of your life, and that he can keep you company on the days when I cannot be there myself.[/size]
[size=4]
As you continue writing the story of your own life, please remember to be kind to yourself ❤️. Many people in this world care about you and love you, including me. I hope you will always have the courage to choose the life you want, and the strength to become the person you wish to be.[/size]
